description_en: Disables the time shifting service for a specified domain name (application or live stream)
description_zh: 关闭指定域名（应用、直播流）的时移服务
kebab_example: aliyun live close-live-shift --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: CloseLiveShift

parameters.help_en: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs. Wildcards (*) are supported, which indicates all AppName values under the domain name. You can view the AppName on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html page
parameters.help_zh: 直播流所属应用名称。支持通配符*，代表该域名下所有的AppName。您可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html页面查看AppName
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the live stream. Wildcards (*) are supported, which indicates all StreamName values under the AppName. You can view the StreamName on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html page
parameters.help_zh: 直播流流名称。支持通配符*，代表该AppName下所有的StreamName。您可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html页面查看StreamName
parameters.name: stream_name
